title: Compute a business-hours SLA deadline
system: You compute business-hours deadlines. Output only the requested time.
prompt:
Business hours are 09:00-17:00 Monday-Friday local time. The SLA is: respond within 4 business hours.
A ticket opened Friday 15:30. When is the deadline?
Reply with exactly this format: Weekday HH:MM using a 24-hour clock and an English weekday name (example: Monday 11:30).
